tidbit: Did you know… about 7,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
David Robinson has left OpenAI to push for stronger artificial intelligence safety from outside the company, reported by Business Insider.
Silicon Valley startup CScale, backed by Nvidia and Intel, raised $145 million and plans to ship artificial intelligence server chips with built-in lasers by 2028, reported by varindia.
Experts warn that artificial intelligence generated beauty images could harm young people's body image and are calling for artificial intelligence literacy and diverse representation, reported by BBC.
A privacy tool revealed what ChatGPT and Claude infer about users based on their chat history, reported by PCMag, and the results were described as terrifyingly accurate.
A public workshop is explaining artificial general intelligence and its effects on work and relationships, reported by KPBS.
Free every hour.
